description: This Ultimate Veggie Burger Patty recipe delivers a satisfying, flavorful experience perfect for any meal. Crafted with wholesome ingredients, these patties are hearty, hold their shape beautifully, and are incredibly versatile. Enjoy a healthier, delicious alternative to traditional burgers that will impress even the most avid meat-eaters.

instructions.title: Prepare Ingredients
instructions.text: Rinse and thoroughly drain the canned black beans. In a large bowl, mash the black beans with a fork until mostly broken down but still retaining some texture. Ensure your brown rice is cooked and cooled.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics and Mushrooms
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the finely diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and finely chopped mushrooms, cooking until the mushrooms release their liquid and are lightly browned, about 7-10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

instructions.title: Combine Patty Mixture
instructions.text: Add the cooled sautéed onion and mushroom mixture, cooked brown rice, beaten egg, breadcrumbs, smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper to the mashed black beans. Mix everything thoroughly with your hands until well combined and a cohesive mixture forms. Do not overmix.

instructions.title: Form the Patties
instructions.text: Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions. Shape each portion into a firm, round patty, about 3/4 to 1 inch thick. Ensure the edges are smooth and the patties are compact to prevent crumbling during cooking.

instructions.title: Chill Patties
instructions.text: Place the formed patties on a plate or baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Chilling helps the patties firm up and hold their shape better during cooking.

instructions.title: Cook the Veggie Burgers
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Carefully place the chilled patties in the hot skillet, ensuring not to overcrowd. Cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until golden brown and heated through. Alternatively, grill on medium heat for 6-8 minutes per side.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Serve your Ultimate Veggie Burger Patties hot on toasted buns with your favorite toppings like lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and a delicious sauce. Enjoy your homemade American vegetarian delight!

tips: For an extra firm patty, add a tablespoon of vital wheat gluten to the mix. It acts as a binder and improves texture, a common technique in American vegetarian cooking.
Experiment with spices! Add a pinch of cayenne for heat, or dried oregano for an Italian twist. You can also substitute black beans with other legumes like lentils or chickpeas for variation.
Cooked patties can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days. They also freeze well; wrap individually and freeze for up to 2 months. Reheat in a skillet or oven.
